name: Iephosama: Digital Curse
summary: Iephosama: Digital Curse is a retro-style horror adventure game set in the summer of 2000. Players investigate the disappearance of a friend linked to a disturbing digital summoning game. With pixel art graphics and a narrative focus, you navigate through atmospheric environments and solve puzzles while uncovering chilling secrets. The game challenges you further by lacking a save feature, intensifying the experience.
